purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a Sa'ueia breeding-ground reserve shortfall during eclipse ingress.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for the west intake terrace, ordinary reserve labor, a prismwake refusal, two unequal family claims, public trophic bargaining, totality allocation, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate anchors for terrace orientation, keeper routine, the routine work hub, its folded result, the single prismwake warning beat, claimant arrival, the shortfall response hub, the public claims fold, the trophic bargain hub, totality threshold, and every ending family. The silver-red bite warning stands alone before Ossa and Rin enter the active frame.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt restates camera, terrace geometry, light, materials, bodies, tools, and placements for a general image model. Character refs are assembled only for named or grouped characters visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Painterly speculative-ecology storybook frame, restrained gouache and ink texture, low-energy bioluminescence, readable alien anatomy, precise living infrastructure, deep eclipse blues against muted amber, teal, silver-rose, and dark mineral earth, warm workplace comedy under material scarcity, cinematic interactive-fiction composition.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble the global_style_cue, each scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups visible in that scene, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Every text-only render receives complete visible terrace geometry. Keep visual_continuity_notes out of prompt text.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one terrace from several angles and branches change cup placement, intake lights, mat repair, herd position, archive display, and ration-rail state. The embedded map fixes those relationships for draft replay planning.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide elevated establishing view of an outdoor alien nursery intake terrace shaped like a low fan of dark root-bound stone. The narrow western mouth meets a living fungal road marked by two parallel rows of thumb-sized amber fruiting candles and two shallow intake channels. The broad eastern edge descends by three low ramps into warm oval nursery hollows. A shallow water channel lined with a thin silver-rose photosynthetic mat runs along the mat-side edge. Thick lantern-tree roots, hanging cold-blue light knots, and a waist-low heat rail occupy the grove-side edge. Three round black-glazed reserve basins and a low ration rail sit in the center. Long-bodied six-limbed Sa'ueia caretakers fold around low cups; each has four tall digitigrade running legs and two smaller three-digit chest manipulators. A broad dark glassback grazer with translucent teal-glowing dorsal plates stands at the heat rail. An enormous fixed black planet begins to cover a dim sun above the terrace.

visible_characters.default_stance: several caretakers folded around basins and moving cups toward the three nursery ramps
broadside at the grove-side heat rail

visual_continuity_notes: Facing nurseryward, west and routeward are behind the central basins, the wet prismwake channel is mat-side, and lantern roots plus the heat rail are grove-side.
The three basins, ration rail, two fungal channels, wet mat channel, heat rail, three nursery ramps, and west road mouth remain fixed across every camera.

review_notes: This fixture requires a durable scene_set because multiple angles and endings depend on fixed relations among the road boundary, basins, ration rail, nursery ramps, mat channel, heat rail, archive, and claimant positions.
The embedded scene_set map fixes draft zones, routes, cameras, sightlines, and state anchors; a hand-authored blockout remains required before high-consistency generated website art.
All base prompts use affirmative visible descriptions and restate the environment for text-only concept rendering.
